name: Shadow puppet (pi ying)
about: This is a leather puppet used in Shaanxi shadow play, a traditional performance art of the region. Xi'an is a center of this craft.
tip: Check that the leather is well made and the hand-painted colors are even.

name: Terracotta Warriors miniature
about: A small copy of the clay soldiers buried near Emperor Qin's tomb. They are Xi'an's most famous sight.
